data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall prior-year reserve surplus of GBP 1.2m in 2015, driven by favourable claims experience predominantly in casualty reinsurance and property reinsurance classes. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 12.419m. No detailed gross prior-year movement breakdown by line is provided; the report cites improved claims experience as the main cause.
raw_causal_phrases: an overall surplus of GBP 1.2m on prior year reserves
better than expected claims experience on casualty reinsurance and property reinsurance classes of business

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet (Liabilities - Technical provisions) prior-year column. The report explicitly states an "overall surplus of GBP 1.2m on prior year reserves"; this figure is stated in narrative but does not specify whether it is gross or net of reinsurance. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line item was provided that unambiguously isolates gross prior-year development; the claims development triangle in the notes contains only 2014 and 2015 columns, insufficient to compute older-years PYD. Therefore the GBP 1.2m figure has been used as the quantified prior-year movement (treated as a release). This is flagged as possibly NET of reinsurance in absence of an explicit gross PYD figure.
